summary: Tactile, physics-driven micro-interactions for buttons, toggles, forms, dialogs, and notifications with strict timing and feedback budgets.
whenToUse: Use when designing feedback animations for buttons, toggles, form validation, dialogs or notifications within tight timing budgets.
verification: Feedback to input starts within 100ms and settles within 300ms.
Destructive actions use a confirm step or Undo, never a long-press.
Under prefers-reduced-motion there is no movement; state is still clear.
